key.name: api-base-url
key.description: Where the ShulGo API v1 lives. Change it only to point at your own ShulGo.

key.name: use-geolocation
key.description: Ask the system where we are (GeoClue). Off, or when it can't say, the typed place is used.

key.name: place
key.description: A city, neighborhood or zip: "Lakewood, NJ", "Boro Park", "11230", "Antwerp".

key.name: location-label
key.summary: What to call the place on screen

key.name: window-minutes
key.summary: How far ahead to look, in minutes

key.name: travel-mode
key.description: Used to work out whether you can still make it in time.

key.name: refresh-seconds
key.summary: How often to ask ShulGo again, in seconds

key.name: panel-text
key.description: full: "Mincha 1:30 · 15m". countdown: "15m". time: "1:30". icon: the icon alone.

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Where in the top bar it sits

key.name: glass
key.description: blur: frosted glass, with the desktop blurred behind it. tint: see-through, no blur. solid: ShulGo navy, nothing showing through.

key.name: location-status
key.summary: How asking this computer for its location went
key.description: Written by the widget, read by its settings window, which is a separate program and cannot see inside it. "off" means the system's own Location Services are switched off.

key.name: seen-timezone
key.summary: The time zone the place was set in
key.description: When the machine's time zone stops matching this, the laptop has probably travelled, and the widget asks whether to look somewhere else. Not a setting anyone needs to touch.

key.name: last-tab
key.summary: The tab that was open last

key.name: list-length
key.summary: How many rows a list in the top-bar menu shows

key.name: migrated-from-jewbuntu
key.summary: Whether the old org.jewbuntu.shulgo settings have been brought across
key.description: Set once, by migrateFromOldNamespace(). Not a preference — nobody should ever change it by hand, and it exists only so the copy happens exactly once. See the shim schema org.jewbuntu.shulgo.gschema.xml, which can be deleted along with this key a release from now.
